name: Firefly Pose
description: Arm balance with the legs extended wide and forward over the arms.

source.title: Yoga Journal Pose Library
source.note: Stick-figure approximation. Twists and binds can't be fully shown in 2D.

setup: Squat with your feet a little narrower than hip-width.
Work your shoulders behind your knees and plant your hands behind your heels.

keyframes.name: Squat
keyframes.cue: Squat low with the hands on the floor in front.

keyframes.name: Firefly Pose
keyframes.cue: Hands down behind the feet, lift the hips, and straighten the legs.

cues: Squeeze the thighs onto the arms.
Point the toes and straighten the knees.
